result.citation: L.A. Mun. Code § 165.00 et seq. (Ord. No. 187737) (Just Cause for Eviction Ordinance); L.A. Mun. Code § 151.09(G)
result.official_quote: The landlord shall perform the acts described in this section within 15 days of service of a written notice of termination described in California Civil Code Section 1946.
result.note: Adopted the lawyer's form, which O030 and O090 confirm, using the title the ordinance itself uses; added the RSO relocation section § 151.09(G) because the card also covers RSO no-fault evictions.
